title: OTECH MPO 12F OM3 LSZH 25M Multi-Mode Fiber Patch Cord

items.h: Type: MPO Female to MPO Female

tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The OTECH MPO 12F OM3 LSZH 25M Multi-Mode Fiber Patch Cord is designed for high-performance, high-density network environments. With 12-fiber MPO connectors and OM3 50/125µm multimode fiber, this 25-meter patch cord supports 40G, 100G, and 400G data transmission, making it ideal for modern data centers, enterprise networks, and backbone fiber systems in Bangladesh.


The LSZH (Low Smoke Zero Halogen) jacket ensures safe indoor installation while providing durable and reliable fiber connectivity for mission-critical applications.


Key Features


  • MPO 12F Connector: High-density fiber interface for efficient space utilization and rapid deployment.
  • OM3 Multimode Fiber (50/125µm): Supports 40G, 100G, and 400G high-speed data transmission.
  • 25-Meter Length: Ideal for connecting racks, switches, servers, and patch panels in large data centers.
  • LSZH Jacket: Low smoke, zero halogen for safe indoor installation.
  • Low Insertion Loss: Ensures stable, high-bandwidth network performance.
  • Durable and Reliable: Factory-tested for consistent performance in critical networks.
  • Compatible With: MPO-enabled switches, SFP/SFP+ modules, optical distribution frames, and high-density enclosures.
